sql.ahj.requirement.add: WITH ar AS ( insert into brs.ahj_requirement(requirement_type_id, description, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id) values (:requirementTypeId, :description, now(), :createdById, now(), :modifiedById) returning id ) INSERT INTO brs.ahj_requirements (ahj_id, requirement_id, status_id, position, date_created, created_by_id, date_modified, modified_by_id, original_requirement_id) SELECT :ahjId, ar.id, :statusId, :position, now(), :createdById, now(), :modifiedById, ar.id FROM ar RETURNING original_requirement_id
sql.ahj.requirement.active.detail: SELECT ar.ahj_id ahjId, ar.archived, ar.position, ar.status_id statusId, ars.name status, ar.complete, ar.date_created dateCreated, ar.created_by_id createdById, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) createdBy, ar.date_modified dateModified, ar.modified_by_id modifiedById, concat(u2.first_name, ' ', u2.last_name) modifiedBy, r.id, r.description, r.requirement_type_id requirementTypeId, ar.original_requirement_id originalRequirementId, art.name requirementType, FROM brs.ahj_requirements ar INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement r ON r.id = ar.requirement_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_type art ON art.id = r.requirement_type_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u ON u.id = ar.created_by_id INNER JOIN flow."user" u2 ON u2.id = ar.modified_by_id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_requirement_status ars ON ars.id = ar.status_id WHERE ar.ahj_id = :ahjId AND ar.original_requirement_id = :originalRequirementId AND ar.status_id = 1 AND ar.archived IS FALSE
sql.ahj.requirement.archive:
UPDATE brs.ahj_requirements SET archived = true, status_id = 2, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById WHERE original_requirement_id = :originalRequirementId;
UPDATE brs.ahj_requirement SET archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById WHERE id IN (select requirement_id from brs.ahj_requirements where original_requirement_id = :originalRequirementId);
